name: GDG Zaragoza
shortDescription: Capítulo de Google Developer Groups en Zaragoza. Organiza talleres y charlas sobre tecnologías de Google, inteligencia artificial y realidad virtual, y ha venido celebrando el DevFest Zaragoza.

shortDescriptionI18n.en: The Google Developer Groups chapter in Zaragoza. It runs workshops and talks on Google technologies, artificial intelligence and virtual reality, and has been organising DevFest Zaragoza.
